moves.name: Sleep Powder
moves.description:
Grass (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 75
Priority: 0
Causes the target to fall asleep.

moves.name: Hurricane
moves.description:
Flying (Special)
Base Power: 110
Accuracy: 70
Priority: 0
Has a 30% chance to confuse the target. This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, this move does not check accuracy. If the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, this move's accuracy is 50%. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 70%.

moves.name: Rage Powder
moves.description:
Bug (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 2
Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from the opposing side are redirected to the user. Such attacks are redirected to the user before they can be reflected by Magic Coat or the Magic Bounce Ability, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod or Storm Drain Abilities. Fails if it is not a Double Battle or Battle Royal. This effect is ignored while the user is under the effect of Sky Drop.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Tailwind
moves.description:
Flying (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
For 4 turns, the user and its party members have their Speed doubled. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's side.

moves.name: Pollen Puff
moves.description:
Bug (Special)
Base Power: 90
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
If the target is an ally, this move restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down, instead of dealing damage.

moves.name: Bug Buzz
moves.description:
Bug (Special)
Base Power: 90
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: U-turn
moves.description:
Bug (Physical)
Base Power: 70
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.

moves.name: Stun Spore
moves.description:
Grass (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 75
Priority: 0
Paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Quiver Dance
moves.description:
Bug (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
Raises the user's Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

items.name: Choice Scarf
items.description: Holder's Speed is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

items.name: Wide Lens
items.description: The accuracy of attacks by the holder is 1.1x.

items.name: Mental Herb
items.description: Cures holder of Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, Torment. Single use.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: Life Orb
items.description: Holder's attacks do 1.3x damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

items.name: Occa Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Fire-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Charti Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Rock-type attack. Single use.

abilities.name: Compound Eyes
abilities.description: This Pokemon's moves have their accuracy multiplied by 1.3.

abilities.name: Friend Guard
abilities.description: This Pokemon's allies receive 3/4 damage from other Pokemon's attacks.

abilities.name: Shield Dust
abilities.description: This Pokemon is not affected by the secondary effect of another Pokemon's attack. Attacks with secondary effects that are prevented include those with a chance (even 100%) to paralyze, sleep, freeze, burn, poison, confuse, cause this Pokemon to flinch, cause this Pokemon's stat stages to be lowered, as well as Anchor Shot, Eerie Spell, Fling, Psychic Noise, Salt Cure, Spirit Shackle, Syrup Bomb, and Throat Chop. The effect of Sparkling Aria is prevented if this Pokemon is the only target. Secondary effects added by King's Rock, Razor Fang, and the Poison Touch, Stench, and Toxic Chain Abilities are also prevented against this Pokemon.
